# Whole-wealth recovery and predecessor-rights supplement

**Control:** PD-PLATFORM-20260920-01 / whole-wealth-and-predecessor-rights supplement  
**Date:** 20 September 2026  
**Parent rule:** [Whole-platform displacement and patrimonial harm](PLATFORM_DISPLACEMENT_PATRIMONIAL_HARM_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_RULE_20SEP2026.md)  
**Thread synthesis:** [PD-PRESIDENCIA-THREAD-20260920-01](../../archive/PRESIDENCIA_PLATFORM_RECOVERY_THREAD_20SEP2026.md)  
**Status:** standing analytical and drafting rule once integrated; not a liability finding, asset restriction, claim filing or new CI gate.

## 1. Controlling scope

Gil Marer directs that the whole wealth of the alleged criminal perimeter be investigated for recovery. Translate 'painted for recovery' into **identified, mapped, classified and assessed for every legally available recovery route**. Do not translate it into blanket guilt, a present lien, collective ownership or automatic confiscation.

For each person or entity against whom a source-supported liability hypothesis exists, investigate the complete economically relevant asset position, including historical holdings, present interests, dispositions, control arrangements and substitutes. Do not exclude an asset from every route merely because it predates 2018, was lawfully acquired, belongs to a different business sector, was financed with mixed money, or cannot yet be traced to a direct Sun Park payment.

The alleged criminal mechanism and each person's involvement must be investigated, not assumed from the word 'perimeter'. No business, employee, guest, investor, family member, adviser or official becomes liable merely through association. Comprehensive discovery and a particular coercive measure have different thresholds.

## 2. Distinct routes and legal bases

| Route | Question and starting reference | Non-inference |
|---|---|---|
| Original property / substitute | What proprietary interest or traceable replacement belongs to a claimant? | A causal connection alone does not establish ownership of every resulting asset |
| Gain-based recovery | Which duty, misuse, assistance or unjust enrichment supports recovery of a particular benefit? | All commercial profits are not automatically accountable |
| Ordinary monetary liability | What assets belong to a liable debtor and can secure/satisfy its obligation? Civil Code art.1911 | An asset need not be criminal proceeds; enforcement must respect title, exemptions, ranking and amount |
| Criminal proceeds/instruments | Penal Code art.127 and related provisions | Allegation and investigation are not a confiscation order |
| Equivalent-value recovery | Penal Code arts.127.3 and127 septies in their proper procedural settings | Lawful-origin property is not always excluded, but the equivalent-value measure is bounded |
| Extended confiscation | Arts.127 bis and127 quinquies–sexies and their predicates | Not automatic against the whole network |
| Transfers to third parties | Art.127 quater and applicable civil avoidance/proprietary routes | A transfer neither always cleanses nor always condemns the property; knowledge and safeguards matter |
| Interim protection | LECrim arts.589 and764; Penal Code art.127 octies; civil precautionary/enforcement provisions | Discovery does not itself freeze assets; basis, risk, amount, proportionality and competent order required |

Primary texts: [Civil Code](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1889-4763), [Penal Code](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1995-25444), [LECrim](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1882-6036), [LEC](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2000-323). Apply the text and temporal regime appropriate to each act/remedy.

Confiscation, civil restitution, damages, insolvency recovery, tax/grant recovery and compensation for public-service harm are not the same remedy. Preserve victims' positions explicitly and reconcile recoveries; do not imply confiscation automatically delivers all value to Aweswell.

## 3. Comparative equity must inform the investigation without inventing a Spanish remedy

The thread used **Foskett v McKeown [2000] UKHL29** for tracing/substitution; **Rukhadze v Recovery Partners [2025] UKSC10** for fiduciary opportunity-derived profits; **Stevens v Hotel Portfolio II [2025] UKSC28** for unauthorised hotel-transaction profits and assistance in dissipation; **Novoship v Nikitin [2014] EWCA Civ908** for the causal/proportional limits of an assistant's account; and **Brazil v Durant [2015] UKPC35** for coordinated transaction/backwards-tracing analysis.

These are comparative, duty-, forum- and remedy-specific references. Establish the fiduciary or other duty rather than assume every counterparty owed one. Do not import a constructive trust, a universal 'but for' rule or ownership of all downstream enterprises into Spanish law by using English terminology. The absence of a direct cash transfer does not settle every profit/opportunity claim, and the existence of a useful causal role does not settle a proprietary claim.

Primary sources reviewed in the thread:
- https://publications.parliament.uk/pa/ld199900/ldjudgmt/jd000518/fosk04.htm
- https://www.supremecourt.uk/cases/judgments/uksc-2023-0062
- https://www.supremecourt.uk/cases/press-summary/uksc-2023-0142
- https://www.bailii.org/ew/cases/EWCA/Civ/2014/908.html
- https://jcpc.uk/uploads/jcpc_2013_0069_judgment_b903daf76e.pdf

Spanish corporate-duty analysis includes LSC arts.227.2 and229 where the particular person's role and duty make them applicable. The insolvency administrator's position has its own regime. Civil Code arts.455 and1106 cover other questions concerning fruits and loss; they must not reduce the whole-platform allegation to rent. EU proceeds concepts may include transformed/reinvested advantages, but the instrument's scope, implementation and safeguards must be examined before use.

## 4. Required wealth and transaction fields

Use the existing canonical graph, not a rival register. For each candidate asset or interest record:

`person/entity and capacity; legal/claimed/beneficial owner; exact interest; location; acquisition date and consideration; source; value basis and uncertainty; debt/charges/ranking; current holder; transfer/control evidence; source of funds or non-cash input; claimant/right; proposed remedy; amount exposure; knowledge/intent where required; alternative explanation; dissipation evidence; competent forum; preservation step; procedural status; missing proof`.

An individual's shares are not the company's hotel. A manager's fee receivable is not the managed hotel. A shareholder loan is not the company's bank account. A company acquisition, asset purchase and universal succession carry different legal consequences.

Maintain linked but separate **claimant-loss**, **recipient-gain** and **present-recovery-asset** ledgers. Avoid double counting principal, debt, investment cost, asset value, revenue, profit, distributions and capitalised future fees. Include mixed contributions, repayment, independent value creation, legitimate costs and third-party ranking.

## 5. Original seller obligations and later adoption

Begin with the asserted 2008 whole-hotel bargain and actual seller obligations. Do not use optional CEXP participation to answer an independent sale promise. Do not assume the eventual fragmented title distribution was the freely intended original endpoint. Conversely, a majority Community decision or a press report alone does not prove authority to sell every individual finca.

For each predecessor-to-CAM chain distinguish:

1. a binding prior sale/option and the exact right-holder;
2. an opposable property/use burden;
3. defined statutory common-expense exposure;
4. an express assumption or contractual subrogation;
5. corporate/universal succession;
6. a challengeable transfer affecting prior creditors/rights;
7. the buyer's own later wrongful participation, adoption, implementation or maintenance.

Registered title, unrestricted disposal, good faith, notice, possession and operating authority are different propositions. A later asset buyer does not automatically inherit every predecessor's personal liability; it also does not automatically acquire a liability-free asset or immunity for its own conduct.

Read the [2008 instruments and Community adoption review](../../archive/MONTELANZA_2008_AND_COMMUNITY_ADOPTION_REVIEW_20SEP2026.md). The recovered subrogation wording is a concrete enquiry, not proof of every buyer's liability. The specific-performance and limitation chain must be checked from the original promise to the present claimant. No private force or self-help seizure is authorised.

## 6. Aweswell and public patrimonial harm remain fully in scope

Preserve AWESWELL LIMITED as British parent/foreign investor and the accounts' distinct shareholder, creditor, funder and wider-platform position, with separate LPB, Matkator and CEXP rights. The fuller accounts state an asserted creditor position exceeding EUR1m and a potential nine-figure recovery profile, but do not recognise that profile as an accounting asset. GBP1 carrying treatment is not a damages valuation; this rule does not certify that accounting method or the exact deposited version.

For public-service harm apply the parent rule's Articles 32–37 matrix. Article32.7 points to the LOPJ Administration-of-Justice regime; Article33 requires the actual basis for concurrent responsibility; Article36 distinguishes a claim against the administration from its recourse against officials; Article37.2 does not impose automatic suspension pending criminal proceedings. The administration/function/act/duty/causation/loss must be identified individually.

The allegation is continuing patrimonial injury, not only a historic lost-property figure. That allegation does not decide limitation: assess fresh injury, continuing conduct, permanent loss and continuing effects separately under Ley39/2015 art.67 and the applicable special regime. Publication, a SAIP, a general reservation and pending criminal work must not be assumed to preserve every deadline.

## 7. Institutional drafting

The requested Government response is competence-respecting: preserve relevant records; independently assess its own functions and reliance; make traceable referrals; and consider lawful prevention/protection measures. Do not ask Presidencia to exercise judicial attachment powers or treat its legal services as the claimant's counsel or an independent tribunal.

A strong formulation is:

> Investigate the whole legally relevant wealth position; establish each participant's liability; identify original/substituted value and legally attributable gains; and preserve access to every asset that may lawfully secure or satisfy the resulting obligations, including general assets where the applicable route permits.

Spanish counterpart:

> Investigar el patrimonio íntegro jurídicamente relevante; individualizar la responsabilidad de cada interviniente; identificar los bienes originarios, los valores de sustitución y los beneficios jurídicamente atribuibles; y preservar la efectividad de la recuperación sobre los bienes que legalmente puedan asegurar o satisfacer las obligaciones resultantes, incluido el patrimonio general del obligado cuando proceda.

The public institutional outline remains **PREPARATION / NOT SENT / NOT FILED**. A separate SAIP concerns existing handling records; neither is a blanket compensation claim. Apply all current privacy, adverse-evidence, source and publication controls.

## 8. 21 September 2026 — attributed 100% platform-provenance supplement

Read `archive/ATTRIBUTED_100_PERCENT_PLATFORM_PROVENANCE_CONTROL_21SEP2026.md` and `assets/data/acosta-matos-platform-provenance-allegation-20260921.json`.

Gil Marer now expressly fixes his party position at **100%**: he alleges that the present assets, income, commercial relationships, reputational/institutional influence, investor/capital access and other economic advantages of the Acosta Matos / RICPE-linked perimeter derive directly or indirectly from the alleged staged displacement and exploitation of the Aweswell / LPB / Matkator / Sun Park platform from 2018. Preserve “100%” as his attributed causal/provenance position; do not dilute it into an unspecified connection.

This supplement does **not** alter the proof/remedy disciplines above. It does not establish a 100% traced-funds result, proprietary ownership of all downstream assets, a confiscation entitlement or collective guilt. The current record materially supports pre-2022 economic use — 2018 control allegations, preserved 2019 Hotel Lava Verde self-presentation at the Sun Park address, 2019–2020 pilots/whole-hotel project work and the 2020 RICPE presentation — while project-by-project causal provenance remains to be proved.

The separate proposition that CAM/Acosta Matos was in poor financial shape in 2017–2018 remains Gil's attributed belief. The current corpus supports a much smaller hospitality/investment footprint but does not yet prove distress; obtain the finite financial records listed in the 21-Sep control.
